morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 edar，é 读 /e/；接 per-...-an 后不发生鼻音同化。资料包将整个派生词标为词根，现依据 DBP 的 edar 词族修正。[DBP：edar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=112548&keyword=edar)

senses.zh_definition: 循环运行；围绕某物运行，或流体沿系统持续流动。
senses.en_definition: Circular or orbital movement; circulation through a system.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal beredar atau bergerak berkeliling; termasuk aliran yang melalui suatu sistem.
senses.nuances: 用于天体运行、血液循环和空气流通。地球绕太阳运行是 peredaran bumi mengelilingi matahari；地球自转通常说 putaran bumi。系统流动义可参见 [DBP：circulation](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=1&k=peredaran)。

collocations.en: the Earth's revolution around the Sun

senses.zh_definition: 从一处到另一处的移动、流转。
senses.en_definition: Movement or passage from one place to another.
senses.ms_definition: Perjalanan atau perpindahan dari satu tempat ke tempat lain.
senses.nuances: 着重移动或流转的过程。表达主动配送商品时，通常用 pengedaran barang。下列为自然组合，不表示其频率经过独立统计。

collocations.ms: peredaran dari satu tempat ke tempat lain
collocations.zh: 从一处到另一处的流转
collocations.en: movement from one place to another
the circulation of goods in the market

senses.zh_definition: 货币在人们之间转手、流通的过程或状态。
senses.en_definition: The circulation of money from one holder to another.
senses.ms_definition: Perpindahan wang dari tangan ke tangan dalam masyarakat.
senses.nuances: 常用于金融报道。wang dalam peredaran 指正在流通的货币；pengedaran wang 则侧重发行或分发行为。

senses.zh_definition: 时代、生活或情况从一种状态向另一种状态的发展、变迁。
senses.en_definition: The passage of time or the development of circumstances from one state to another.
senses.ms_definition: Perkembangan atau perubahan daripada suatu keadaan kepada keadaan yang lain, khususnya perubahan masa atau zaman.
senses.nuances: mengikut peredaran zaman 表示顺应时代变化，常见于教育、商业和社会评论。上述基本义项依据 [DBP：peredaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=peredaran)。

collocations.en: to keep pace with the times

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 业务规划
dual_scenarios.ms: Syarikat perlu menyesuaikan strategi perniagaannya mengikut peredaran zaman.
dual_scenarios.zh: 公司需要顺应时代变化，调整经营策略。
dual_scenarios.en: The company needs to adapt its business strategy to keep pace with the times.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事讨论工作方式
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Zaman dah berubah, kita pun kena ikut peredaran zaman lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Zaman sudah berubah, maka kita juga perlu mengikut peredaran zaman.
dual_scenarios.zh: 时代都变了，我们也得跟上啊。
dual_scenarios.en: Times have changed, so we've got to keep up too.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略
lah 增添劝说或强调语气

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Semua borang dah dalam talian sekarang. Kita kena ikut peredaran zaman lah.
messages.ms_standard: Semua borang kini tersedia dalam talian. Kita perlu mengikut peredaran zaman.
messages.zh: 现在表格都放网上了，我们得跟上时代啦。
messages.en: All the forms are online now. We've got to keep up with the times.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul juga. Nanti ajar aku isi kat telefon je, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Betul juga. Nanti ajar saya mengisi borang itu melalui telefon sahaja, ya.
messages.zh: 也是。回头教我直接用手机填吧。
messages.en: Fair point. Show me how to fill it in on my phone later, okay?

etymology.historical_story: Peredaran belongs to the Malay family built on edar, expressing movement, circulation and change. Its meanings connect several familiar experiences: heavenly bodies travel around an orbit, money passes between people, and circumstances change with time. The expression peredaran zaman makes that connection especially memorable, presenting historical change through the vocabulary of movement. This explains its semantic range without claiming an undocumented origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 edar 记作“转、流转”：per- + edar + -an，把动作变成“循环、流通、变迁”这一过程。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性、规范词，适用于课堂、公文和工作汇报；日常聊天中的 peredaran zaman 稍有议论色彩。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 劝长辈接受新做法时，直接说 mesti ikut peredaran zaman 可能显得说教；可用 mungkin kita boleh mencuba cara baharu 来缓和。
